name: Penang Heritage Kopi Roasting Station
description: Original static exhibit inspired by Penang coffee-roasting workshops: an open recessed pot set into a masonry base, two parked paddles, and a separately displayed pulley and cord.
summary: Static Penang-inspired workshop display with a recessed pot, supported paddles and a separate true rope groove.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Original independently modeled curved masonry, solid thick-walled pot, raised bean sample, separate paddles and static grooved pulley with open wrap; native Cycles poster.
rights: Original project asset; redistribution terms for public downloads are not specified.
accuracy_notes: Interpretive original scene, not the surviving equipment of a named vendor. The pulley stand is not mechanically connected to the pot. No real heat, recipe or operating process. Blender -Y front/+Z up, glTF +Z front/+Y up.

attribution.credit: All geometry, materials, placard and preview are original.
